_readme: An EXAMPLE bank, and the shape a real one takes. Every question here carries
"disclosable": true for one reason only: this file is committed to a public
repository, so its answers are already published and echoing one back in a
finished session's review gives away nothing.
If you copy this file and write your own questions, DELETE the flag. It is
false when absent, and false is what a hand-written question needs: a player
is still told which ones they got right, but the right option is not named,
because sessions need no signature and anyone can open them under addresses
they invent. See Question.disclosable in bank.ts.
The importer at spike/import-opentdb.ts sets the flag itself, because every
question it writes comes from a public API whose answers anyone can download.

questions.prompt: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
What gas do plants absorb from the air during photosynthesis?
Which wall divided a European capital until 1989?
How many strings does a standard violin have?
Which language contributed the word 'algebra' to English?
